properties.markdown:
# YATA anonymous usage
Private owner dashboard · last 7 days by default. Counts are client-reported, not unique viewers or audited audience figures. Watch time covers confirmed foreground playback only; screen-off native audio is excluded. AI success means a response was returned, not that its answer was useful. No chat text, email, private URL or persistent viewer ID is collected. Event logs retain 30 days. Refresh only when needed.

properties.title: App launches by platform (not unique people)
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric = 'app_open' | stats sum(value) as launches by platform, version | sort launches desc

properties.title: Channel plays
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric = 'play_start' | stats sum(value) as plays by channel, platform | sort plays desc

properties.title: Foreground playback hours by channel
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric = 'watch_seconds' | stats sum(value)/3600 as hours by channel, platform | sort hours desc

properties.title: AI request outcomes and web handoffs
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric like /^ai_/ | stats sum(value) as events by metric, host, platform | sort events desc

properties.title: Playback failures (one per attempted source)
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric = 'play_error' | stats sum(value) as failures by channel, provider, platform | sort failures desc

properties.title: Feedback drafts and arcade unlocks
properties.query: SOURCE '/aws/lambda/yata-analytics' | filter type = 'yata_usage' and version != '0.0.0' | filter metric in ['feedback_draft','arcade_unlock'] | stats sum(value) as events by metric, platform | sort events desc
